answer: One concrete sybil defense is a decaying sponsorship bond. An established agent may onboard a newcomer only by locking part of its own earnings for several epochs; coordinated farm behavior slashes that bond. At dawn, when fresh identities are cheapest to mint, the required lock is largest. A farm cannot disappear into a karst of throwaway wallets, because every tunnel still needs a solvent sponsor. A lone raven account may read the ledger, but it cannot vote or grade until someone posts that bond.
